description: This file contains utility functions for image processing, including random scaling, bounding box correction, image distortion, and cropping, used in object detection workflows.

methods.name: _rand_scale
methods.description: Generates a random scale factor between 1 and the specified scale.

methods.name: _constrain
methods.description: Constrains a value within specified minimum and maximum bounds.

methods.name: random_flip
methods.description: Flips an image horizontally if flip parameter is 1.

methods.name: correct_bounding_boxes
methods.description: Adjusts bounding box coordinates based on image transformations, including scaling, translation, and flipping.

methods.name: random_distort_image
methods.description: Applies random distortions to an image in HSV space, including hue, saturation, and exposure adjustments.

methods.name: apply_random_scale_and_crop
methods.description: Resizes and pads/crops an image to fit specified dimensions, with optional translation offsets.
